messages:
elaine_cs: Quick heads-up — Acero prod is at ~80% of their monthly token quota and we saw a 40% week-over-week usage increase. Latency looks fine avg=120ms but error rate nudged from 0.3% -> 1.2% last 24h. Thinking we should do a temporary quota bump + proactive comms. Thoughts?

sam_pricing: Can you paste the spend delta if we bump them? Need to know price impact before approving. Also which quota: tokens or concurrent requests?

elaine_cs: Tokens. Current limit 10M/mo. Suggest +50% to 15M for 7 days while we investigate. Estimated incremental cost ~ $1.8k based on current usage pattern.

ryan_support: Error spike correlates with a deploy at 03:18 UTC yesterday, a small retry storm from their side. Logs show a lot of 429 and some upstream 503s. Example: ```
[2024-06-30T03:18:42Z] acct=acero req=abc123 status=429 tokens=1200
[2024-06-30T03:19:01Z] acct=acero req=def456 status=503 upstream_timeout
```

ryan_support: I don't think the spike is pricing-related, more request pattern + concurrent bursts. We should still do bump to avoid immediate throttling.

marco_success_eng: Agree. Proactive comms + temporary increase = low customer friction. Proposed plan: 1) Approve 7-day token bump to 15M (ops to apply) 2) Send a short heads-up email explaining temporary bump + ask for peak windows + ask to stagger retries 3) Monitor usage/latency/errors and reconvene Wed 48h check-in.

elaine_cs: Draft email below. Please edit.

marco_success_eng: ```
Subject: Temporary quota increase & request for peak info

Hi {{AcctTeam}},

We noticed higher-than-usual usage for your Redwood account and want to avoid any service disruption. We've applied a temporary quota increase from 10M -> 15M tokens for 7 days while we investigate. No action needed to continue sending requests.

To help us stabilize performance, could you share any expected spike windows or recent changes to request patterns? If you can stagger retries or reduce parallel clients during your peak, that will help reduce errors. If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min call to review traffic.

We'll monitor closely and follow up before the 7 days end.

— Marco (Redwood Customer Success)
```

sam_pricing: Looks good. Add one line about cost — "This temporary increase is at our discretion and we will follow up on long-term capacity / pricing if the usage persists."

elaine_cs: added. Ops: can you run the quota change and tag the ticket? ops-bot: pls confirm SLA/automation impact.

ops-bot: [automated] Quota change request created: id=Q-20240630-771, account=acero, from=10M, to=15M, duration=7d. Scheduled change: immediate. Monitoring alert rule attached.

ryan_support: I'll add a dashboard watch and set an alert for error rate >1% or latency >250ms. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/accounts/acero

marco_success_eng: Action items:
- elaine_cs: send email within 1h (include Sam's cost line)
- ops: apply quota change and add note to billing if bump persists
- ryan_support: monitor and ping here if error rate doesn't fall within 6h
- marco_success_eng: follow up with Acero PM in 48h for peak windows

elaine_cs: sending now. will paste thread id once sent. :mailbox_with_mail:

ryan_support: thanks — will watch alerts and escalate to eng-runtime if >5% errors or any 5xx surge.

elaine_cs: sent to Acero PM (thread: https://mail.redwood.ai/t/acero/msgs/5543). ops-bot updated ticket Q-20240630-771 -> status=applied.

ops-bot: [automated] Quota change applied. New monthly token cap for account 'acero' = 15M until 2024-07-07T03:18:00Z. Audit log: /internal/audit/Q-20240630-771

marco_success_eng: Great. We'll regroup Wed 48h check-in. If metrics look stable, we'll propose a targeted long-term bump or rate-limit tuning. :white_check_mark:
